actual: CustomEvoLoopConfig.runtime_flags only has scalar random_seed/seed_policy/archive_policy. The loop has a single model_id and action_type custom_config. Model catalog/registry has no seed-ensemble model concept, and runtime orchestration has no aggregation point after score generation or after portfolio generation.
closure_requirements: CustomEvoLoopConfig accepts optional ensemble block with explicit deterministic seeds and preserves disabled/absent single-seed behavior bitwise.
Score-level seed ensemble trains each configured seed, aggregates pred.pkl scores by mean/rank_mean/median, then runs a single pred-backtest so enhanced_metrics fields keep existing schema/units.
Runtime metadata is persisted in loop config/runtime_flags/execution manifest and kept out of Qlib strategy kwargs.
Fixed ensemble seeds produce deterministic aggregation; random_seed is normalized from explicit ensemble seeds when scalar random_seed is omitted.
Portfolio-level ensemble evaluates equal-weight merged daily target holdings and aligns with offline holdings-average proxy evidence.
Regression tests cover schema normalization, config building, composer YAML, executor payload, runner aggregation helpers, and single-seed fallback behavior.

evidence_uris: user report 2026-06-02: custom_evo seed variance 70%-108% CAGR and missing seed ensemble schema/runtime
expected: A custom_evo config can specify explicit ensemble seeds and aggregation level/operator. With ensemble.enabled=true, a loop emits one standard enhanced_metrics/IC/turnover result using deterministic aggregation. With ensemble absent or disabled, existing single random_seed behavior remains bitwise identical.
